title: 1999 paper 'When Disclosure Serves Secrecy'

tellings.quote: in 99 1999. Go look it up. I wrote a paper and it's called when disclosure serves secrecy.

plain: Back in 1999, Steven Greer, a researcher who campaigns for the government to reveal what it knows about UFOs, wrote a paper called "When Disclosure Serves Secrecy", or so he tells Michels, adding "Go look it up." As its title suggests, the idea is that a controlled release of information about UFOs can actually help keep the real secrets hidden.
